name: circle/api
description: CIRCLE private groups API — lightweight PHP/MySQL REST backend

suggest.ext-gd: Required to accept photo uploads (decode JPEG/PNG/WebP, re-encode to WebP, strip EXIF/GPS, resize). Without it media uploads fail closed with 503.
suggest.ext-exif: Applies the camera orientation before metadata is stripped.
suggest.ext-fileinfo: Required for media uploads: real-content sniffing (enabled by default in PHP builds).
